title: Spin with a partner
situation: Right hands joined at a shared grip point, the two of them walk half a circle round it facing each other and exchange places, then let go together. The grip point never moves, so the hands cannot drift apart.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
